title: Knowledge goals graph ({{ stores.design.name }} SSOT store)
description: Schema for {{ stores.design.path }}, written solely by curriculum-architect. Encodes the Baseline/Prerequisite/DesiredResult nodes and Requires edges described in .claude/agents/curriculum-architect.md. `personas` is just the list of persona ids used elsewhere in this file (as audience/held_by/etc.) — persona definitions (name, cohort_count, ...) live in the {{ stores.student_personas.name }} SSOT ({{ stores.student_personas.path }}, currently markdown), so there is nothing to $ref here. Node/edge arrays must be sorted by id for stable, git-diffable output. Canvas/layout positions are never stored here.

course_name.description: The course this graph belongs to.

personas.description: List of persona ids referenced elsewhere in this graph (audience/held_by/persona_variant). Ids must match {{ stores.student_personas.name }} ({{ stores.student_personas.path }}); definitions (name, cohort_count, ...) are not duplicated here.

nodes.description: Baseline, Prerequisite, and DesiredResult nodes, sorted by id.

edges.description: Requires edges: <from> Requires <to> means <to> must be understood before tackling <from>. Sorted by (from, to).

audience.description: Personas this node is for. "all" is the default; narrow to a list when a persona must not be required to hold the node.

id.description: <TYPE>-<MNEMONIC>, mnemonic derived from `key`, never a sequence number. Unique.

key.description: Representative unique short mnemonic key, e.g. deploy-route.

description.description: Human-readable description, detailed enough for a later role to build an assessment from it.

persona_variant.description: Optional, only where the same node is genuinely reached differently by different personas. One entry per persona that differs.

held_by.description: Baseline only: persona ids that already hold this knowledge. A baseline held by only some personas is the normal case.

root.description: Prerequisite only: true for a deliberate root (no incoming edge, on purpose).

root_rationale.description: Required alongside root: true — one-line rationale for why this Prerequisite has no incoming edge.

from.description: Id of the node that Requires `to` — the node that cannot be tackled before `to` is understood.

to.description: Id of the node that must be understood first.

reason.description: Rationale for the edge, e.g. why B must be understood before A.
